run_nfg_writer_example: run the nfg_writer example to convert a game to NFG format using pyspiel.load_game and pyspiel.game_to_nfg_string
run_export_nfg_to_file: run the nfg_writer example to export game NFG string to a specified output file
run_convert_matrix_rps_to_nfg: run the nfg_writer example to convert the matrix_rps game to NFG text format
run_convert_game_to_nfg_string: run the nfg_writer example to convert any pyspiel game to NFG string representation
run_nfg_writer_with_flags: run the nfg_writer example with --game and --outfile flags to control game selection and output destination
